name: Five-Petal Wildflower
gauge: Gauge is not critical; use a firm tension so the small petals hold their rounded shape.

steps.label: Rnd 1
steps.text: With centre yarn, make an MR. Ch 1, work 5 sc into the MR. Pull the ring closed and join with a sl st in the first sc. Fasten off, leaving a 10 cm tail.

steps.label: Rnd 2
steps.text: Join petal yarn with a sl st in any centre st. In that same st, work (sc, hdc, dc, hdc, sc). In each of the next 4 centre sts, work (sc, hdc, dc, hdc, sc).

finishing: Fasten off the petal yarn, leaving a 12 cm tail if the flower will be sewn to a hoop or stem.
Weave the centre yarn end and any unused petal yarn end into the reverse side of the flower.
Gently spread the five petals with your fingers so they sit evenly around the centre.
notes: To secure the flower to a botanical hoop arrangement, use the long petal-yarn tail to sew through the flower centre and around the chosen stem or hoop covering.
